scope.output: 宿直 (the mansion on duty for a given day) from an observed lunar position

conditions.question_in_source: the rishi asks how 宿直 can be fixed when the mansions are unequal in width and the Moon runs ahead of or behind the schematic value
conditions.answer_form: 凡月宿有三種合法 — three classes of lunar conjunction, one per mansion

classes.gloss: the mansion lies ahead; the Moon has not yet reached it but the day is still reckoned to it
the Moon runs alongside; on, before, after, north or south of the mansion all count to it
the mansion follows behind the Moon 'as a calf follows its mother'

conclusion.closure_check: 6 + 12 + 9 = 27; the three classes are disjoint and exhaust the operative cycle, and 牛 belongs to none of them
conclusion.mnemonic_verse: 六宿未到名前合，十二宿月左右合，九宿如犢隨從母
conclusion.source_instruction: 當以此頌復驗之於天 — the text instructs that the verse be verified against the sky, i.e. it treats the schematic rule as an approximation to observation rather than a replacement for it

exceptions: The two statements of the mnemonic verse differ in their final line: T21.0388c06 reads 奎宿直應當知耳 and T21.0395b13 reads 從奎宿數應當知. Both are recorded; neither is emended.

conditions.offset_definition: offset = (index(target) - index(subject 命宿)) mod 27, using sukuyo.mansion.canonical_order
conditions.requires: both mansions drawn from the 27 operative mansions

conclusion.algorithm: if offset mod 9 == 0 then the category is the triad head for that nine (0 -> 命, 9 -> 業, 18 -> 胎); otherwise the category is [榮, 衰, 安, 危, 成, 壞, 友, 親][(offset mod 9) - 1]
conclusion.double_statement: the chapter-3 statement and the fascicle-2 三必祕要法 statement give the same table, the second with explicit ordinal positions 第一 through 第二十七
conclusion.note: This is the single most directly implementable rule in the tradition: two birth mansions determine the category with no interpretive latitude.

conditions.agent: the five planets and the two luminaries offending, pressing, guarding or overrunning a mansion
conditions.discriminator: which three-nine category the afflicted mansion holds relative to the subject's 命宿

affliction_of_favourable.result: 所求不遂、百事迍邅 — what is sought is not obtained and the hundred affairs are obstructed
affliction_of_favourable.response: 亦宜修福念善 / 亦宜修福

affliction_of_unfavourable.result: 所求稱意、百事通達 — what is sought accords with one's wish and the hundred affairs pass through; the 三必 witness adds 官宦遷轉求者皆遂 (promotion sought is obtained)

conclusion.significance: affliction is not a scalar misfortune. Its sign depends on the category of the mansion afflicted, so a planet striking a bad mansion is good news. Any engine that scores transits as uniformly negative contradicts this text.
conclusion.operational_note: the text says the planetary positions must be obtained from the astronomical official (當須問知司天者), i.e. it treats the ephemeris as external input rather than supplying one — which is what T1308 supplies

scope.system: 七曜 (the seven luminaries as weekday rulers)

conditions.definition: 夫七曜，日、月、五星也 — the seven luminaries are the Sun, the Moon and the five planets

conclusion.cycle: 一日一易，七日一周，周而復始 — one changes each day, one revolution in seven days, then begins again

transmission_evidence.instruction: 忽不記得，但當問胡及波斯并五天竺人總知 — if you forget which day it is, simply ask a Sogdian, a Persian, or a person of the Five Indias; they all know
transmission_evidence.religious_note: 尼乾子末摩尼，常以密日持齋，亦事此日為大日 — Nirgranthas and Manichaeans keep a fast on 密日 (Sunday, Sogdian mir) and serve it as the great day
transmission_evidence.significance: the text documents its own Iranian and Indian transmission in its own words. This is the passage that most directly refutes any attempt to read Sukuyodo as a branch of Onmyodo's yin-yang and five-phase system.

conclusion.no_anchor_supplied: T1299 gives the cycle but no epoch for it; a weekday for a historical date must come from a named calendar authority, not from this text

scope.system: 七曜直日 as a birth factor

conditions.trigger: 若人此曜直日生者 / 若人此日生者 — a person born on the day this luminary presides
conditions.requires: a weekday derived from a named calendar authority, which this pack does not have

delineations.verbatim: 法合足智策、端政美貌、孝順短命
合多智策、美貌、樂福田、好布施、孝順
法合醜陋惡性、妨親害族，便弓馬多嗔
(no natal clause is given in the chapter-4 entry)
法合短命好善，人皆欽慕
法合少病、足聲名、少孝順、信朋友

conclusion.asymmetry: Mercury's entry omits the natal clause that the other six carry. The gap is recorded, not filled by inference.
conclusion.suppressed_content: the Sun and Venus clauses both contain 短命 (short life) and the Mars clause contains 醜陋 (ugly) and 妨親害族 (harms kin and injures the clan). These are refused for customer output.
conclusion.adjacent_content_not_natal: each entry also carries an annual omen (若五月五日得此曜者) and an eclipse/earthquake omen (若有虧蝕地動者). Those are mundane omens about the year and the state, not statements about a person, and must not be folded into a natal reading.

scope.system: 七曜直日與二十七宿合 — weekday luminary combined with the mansion on duty

inputs: the presiding luminary of the day
the mansion the Moon is with that day
conditions.form: three named classes, each a seven-row table with exactly one mansion per weekday

classes.name: 羅剎日
classes.judgment: 不宜舉百事，必有殃禍 — unfit for undertaking anything; calamity will follow

textual_problems.冒: the 羅剎日 Sun row reads 月與冒合. 冒 is not a mansion name. It is most plausibly a graphic error for 昴, but 昴 already occupies the 金剛峯日 Mercury row, so the emendation is not free. Recorded unemended.
textual_problems.底: the 羅剎日 Jupiter row reads 月與底合. 底 is not a mansion name; 氐 is the obvious candidate. Recorded unemended.
textual_problems.consequence: two of the twenty-one pairs are unusable until a facsimile or a second witness settles the characters. The other nineteen are clean.

conclusion.note: these tables pair a weekday with a specific mansion, so they only fire on the days the two coincide — roughly 21 qualifying days in each 189-day (7 x 27) period

scope.applies_to: any use of T1308 alongside T1299

observed_in_t1308: 命得二十八宿神下 — twenty-eight mansion deities are summoned, not twenty-seven
a 宿度法 section apportioning mansions in 度 by cardinal quadrant, in which 牛 receives an entry alongside 亢
a different definition of 命宿: 其宿四世界眾生所生之日時，日月行所在為之命宿 — the mansion where the Sun and Moon are at the time of birth
a twelve-place scheme (命宮, 財宮, 兄弟, 田宅, 男女, 僮僕, 妻妾, 疾病, 遷移, 官位, 福相, 困窮) evaluated against the seven luminaries plus 羅睺 and 計都

conclusion.ruling: T1308 and T1299 are different systems and may not be merged
specific_prohibitions: do not use T1308's 28-mansion degree apportionment to locate a T1299 birth mansion
do not treat T1308's 命宿 (Sun-and-Moon position at birth) as T1299's 命宿 (the mansion of the lunar birth day) — they are computed differently and will disagree
do not import T1308's twelve places into T1299's twelve 宮; the former are topical houses, the latter are zodiacal signs
conclusion.additional_gate: T1308's tables are printed as grids in the Taisho and CBETA's linearization of them is unusable as data. The quadrant degree totals read 東方七十五度, 北方九十八度, 西方八十度, 南方百一十三度, which sum to 366 rather than the 365.25 of a Chinese 周天. Recorded as observed; not corrected, and not encoded.
conclusion.why_acquired: to prove the schemes are separable, and because T1299 explicitly outsources planetary positions to an ephemeris it does not contain

conditions.claim_under_test: that Sukuyodo can be treated as a Japanese variant of Onmyodo, or that the two may share rules, sources or vocabulary

textual_grounds: T1299's own weekday chapter names its transmitters as Sogdians, Persians and people of the Five Indias, and gives Sogdian, Persian and Sanskrit names for each weekday planet
the operative units are the 27 Indian nakshatra-derived mansions, the 12 rashi-derived signs and the 7 planetary weekdays — none of which is a yin-yang or five-phase unit
the text carries no sexagenary stem-and-branch reckoning, no shikiban board, no directional deity taboo system, and no five-phase generation or conquest sequence
the ritual remedies prescribed are Buddhist tantric ones — abhisheka, homa, mantra recitation, the establishment of a ritual site
repository_consequence: the onmyodo/ track and the sukuyodo/ track share no source, no rule and no vector
no Sukuyodo rule may cite an Onmyodo source and no Onmyodo rule may cite a Sukuyodo source
a reading that presents them as one Japanese system is refused
conclusion.institutional_note: in Japan the two were separate offices with separate practitioners (sukuyoshi against onmyoji) who competed for calendrical authority. This pack states that on its reading of the text; the modern secondary literature that would corroborate it is recorded in sources/access_manifest.json as leads, not as cited authority.
